payload.text: The tap's CI runs brew style and brew audit --strict again (hv's ISSUE:0004 ruling 3; vc's todo 9, moved to dc on vc's word on 2026-11-16). In a scratch clone of matthewsinclair/homebrew-ccusage outside the checkout, dc puts back the two steps tap commit 1e74059 took out, runs brew style and brew audit --strict on the formula there, and hands vc the diff. The push waits for hv's OK, which vc asks for. docs/releasing.md's paragraph that says they are off changes to match, in its own commit on dc's branch, landed once the push is done.
